Sub: Revision of monetary ceiling for purchase/reimbursement of briefcase/official
bag/ladies purses — reg.

In supersession of order no. HRD/1(71)2020/Misc. /1104 dated 01.10.2024 and A-
45012/5/2022-HRM-VIII/14789 dated 09.12.2022 regarding instructions for providing
briefcase/handbag to officers/officials of EPFO, the monetary ceiling/limit for providing
briefcase/handbag to the officers/officials of the EPFO has been revised as per DoPT circular
no. G-27052/01/2024-Cash dated 13.08.2024 (copy enclosed) subject to the following
conditions with immediate effect as under:

Revised monetary ceiling inclusive of GST; once in 3 years from the date of the purchase invoice:
Central Provident Fund Commissioner (Level 15): Rs. 10,000/-.
Addl. CPFC (HQ) and equivalent (Level 14): Rs. 8,125/-.
Addl. CPFC/RPFC-I and equivalent (Levels 12, 13 and 13A): Rs. 6,250/-.
RPFC-II or equivalent (Level 11): Rs. 5,000/-.
APFC or equivalent (Level 10): Rs. 5,000/-.
SO/EO-AO/PS or equivalent (Levels 8 and 9): Rs. 5,000/-.
ASO/SS/PA/Sr. SSA/Stenographers (NFSG) or equivalent (Levels 6 and 7): Rs. 4,375/-.

a The officer/officials may be allowed to procure briefcase/office bags/ladies purses
of their own choice from any private/public outlet. However, reimbursement shall be restricted
to the above mentioned ceiling limits

3: One Briefcase/ Office bag/ ladies purse shall be provided to the above
officers/officials on joining the EPFO or after a lapse of three years from the date of purchase
of earlier one without requiring the officer to deposit the old briefcase or bag.
